idris.name: iret_12__show_idris
idris.note: A TMS state as an Idris expression, for pasting a run's states back as literals.

idris.name: Iret_12__state
idris.note: The engine state with truth maintenance: the core state and the dependency table.

idris.name: Ltim_2_5_1__tms_inv
idris.note: The frame invariant on the engine with the dependency table: the plain invariant, unique ids, every row targeting an emitted kind.

idris.name: iret_12__net_state_eta
idris.note: The engine with truth maintenance is its core and its table.

idris.name: Iret_12__net_state
idris.note: The network engine and the dependency table: a row per (rule, token identity, logical fact), as on FireLoop's side.

idris.name: iret_12__list_split
idris.note: A list is empty or not.

idris.name: iret_12__live_test_rot
idris.note: The token's liveness test, rearranged as the activation's.

idris.name: iret_12__maybe_split
idris.note: A value is absent or present.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__transfer_canonical
idris.note: THE CANONICAL TRANSFER: a canonical replay from FireLoopTms's empty state is a canonical replay from the loaded network, with the same fuel per input, and the states agree at its end.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__transfer_tms
idris.note: THE TRANSFER THEOREM WITH TRUTH MAINTENANCE: run on one history from the loaded network and from FireLoopTms's empty state under the program the network lowers to, the two engines reach one working memory and one dependency table, and each table's unblocked tokens are the terminal's activations, in order and with their flags. Every theorem stated over FireLoopTms's run -- Rete/TmsRun.idr, Lcyc/TmsTermination.idr, Rete/PumpBoundary.idr -- is a theorem about the spec's network.

idris.name: Iret_12__fact
idris.note: Facts are naturals; only identity is consulted.

idris.name: Iret_12__sub
idris.note: Subset as a membership implication.

idris.name: iret_12__all_in
idris.note: Every antecedent live.

idris.name: iret_12__all_in_elem
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Every antecedent live gives each antecedent live.

idris.name: iret_12__all_in_false
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Not every antecedent live exhibits one that is not.

idris.name: iret_12__all_in_from
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Every antecedent live, from a proof per antecedent.

idris.name: iret_12__all_in_sub
idris.note: All-live is monotone in the live set.

idris.name: iret_12__bool_false_of
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A Bool that is not True is False.

idris.name: iret_12__bool_split
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A Bool is True or False, decidably.

idris.name: iret_12__elem
idris.note: Bool membership, by structural recursion.

idris.name: iret_12__elem_elem
idris.note: Bool membership gives `Elem`.

idris.name: iret_12__elem_filter
idris.note: Membership survives a filter it passes.

idris.name: iret_12__elem_filter_inv
idris.note: Membership in a filter is membership plus the test.

idris.name: iret_12__elem_head
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. The head is a member.

idris.name: iret_12__elem_tail
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A member of the tail is a member.

idris.name: iret_12__elem_true
idris.note: `Elem` gives Bool membership.

idris.name: iret_12__filter_all
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A test true on every member filters nothing.

idris.name: iret_12__filter_full
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A filter as long as its input is its input.

idris.name: iret_12__filter_imp_lt
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. And strictly fewer when the two filters differ.

idris.name: iret_12__filter_imp_lte
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A stronger test keeps no more than a weaker one, on one list.

idris.name: iret_12__filter_lte
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A filter is no longer than its input.

idris.name: iret_12__filter_neq_lt
idris.note: THE counting fact both fuel arguments rest on: a filter that changes something is strictly shorter than its input. Total, no holes.

idris.name: iret_12__filter_sub
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A filter is a subset of its input.

idris.name: iret_12__imp_tail
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A pointwise implication on a list restricts to its tail.

idris.name: iret_12__len_zero
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Length zero is the empty list.

idris.name: iret_12__nat_eq_refl
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Bool equality on naturals is reflexive.

idris.name: iret_12__nat_eq_true
idris.note: Boolean equality on naturals is propositional equality.

idris.name: iret_12__nonempty
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A list with a member is nonempty.

idris.name: iret_12__not_false
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. False means negation true.

idris.name: iret_12__not_true
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. Negation true means false.

idris.name: iret_12__or_inv
idris.note: Counting or membership lemma of the fixpoint theorems, named under the clause it serves ([RFCS.19.1]'s `rfcs_19_1__take` is the precedent); total, no holes. A true disjunction has a true side.

idris.name: iret_12__or_true_l
idris.note: Bool disjunction, left.

idris.name: iret_12__or_true_r
idris.note: Bool disjunction, right.

idris.name: iret_12__supported
idris.note: `justif_count > 0` counted against a live set: some justification targets the fact and has every antecedent live. The count itself is not kept, only whether it is positive, which is all retraction reads.

idris.name: iret_12__supported_mono
idris.note: Support is monotone in the live set.

idris.name: iret_12__and_both
idris.note: Conjunction introduction on Bool.

idris.name: iret_12__cons_not_nil
idris.note: List constructors are distinct.

idris.name: iret_12__elem_filter_false
idris.note: A member the filter lost failed the test.

idris.name: iret_12__elem_nonempty
idris.note: A list with a member is not of length zero.

idris.name: iret_12__filter_nil_all
idris.note: An empty filter rejected every member.

idris.name: iret_12__head_of_length
idris.note: A list of positive length has a member.

idris.name: Iret_12__fire_inv
idris.note: THE FIRING INVARIANT, between the actions of one firing: the run invariant, and the firing activation tracked -- its reading holds and it is live whenever its antecedents are, which is what the fresh id's avoid list buys.

idris.name: Iret_12__run_inv
idris.note: THE RUN INVARIANT, between actions: the core invariant, unique ids, every live row reads as a match, and every row is live -- the cascade that ended the last action ran to its fixpoint.

idris.name: Iret_12__run_inv_s
idris.note: The run invariant of a state.

idris.name: iret_12__all_in_back
idris.note: Ids all live after a change that added no fact with one of them were all live before.

idris.name: iret_12__all_in_not_live
idris.note: An id not live is not among ids that are all live.

idris.name: iret_12__elem_set_at
idris.note: A member survives `set_at`, itself or transformed.

idris.name: iret_12__elem_singleton
idris.note: The member of a singleton.

idris.name: iret_12__length_append
idris.note: Length of an append.

idris.name: iret_12__lte_b
idris.note: The order on Nat as a Bool, for the fresh-id search.

idris.name: iret_12__lte_b_refl
idris.note: Reflexive.

idris.name: iret_12__lte_b_succ
idris.note: At least n + 1 is at least n.

idris.name: iret_12__lte_b_succ_self
idris.note: n + 1 is not at most n.

idris.name: iret_12__lte_zero
idris.note: At most zero is zero.

idris.name: iret_12__not_of_true
idris.note: Negation of a true Bool.

idris.name: iret_12__or_false_split
idris.note: A false disjunction has two false sides.

idris.name: iret_12__run_inv_certified
idris.note: And for a program certified at kind level, on any input with unique ids, with the certificate's domain: the core's initial invariant and its range supply the premises. `partial`: a program [LCYC.3.1.1] admits only through [LCYC.6.1]'s literal break has no kind-level certificate.

idris.name: iret_12__run_inv_holds
idris.note: THE RUN INVARIANT HOLDS. From an invariant-satisfying start with unique ids, every state a run reaches satisfies it; so at every action of every firing `iret_12_2__action_cascade` applies, and the live facts after the action are Rete/Refcount.idr's cascade of the engine's table. Positive programs, emitted values in the domain.

idris.name: iret_12__run_row_live
idris.note: Between actions every row is live with a live target.

idris.name: iret_12__tms_inj
idris.note: Constructor injectivity for the engine state.

idris.name: iret_12__lt_lte_b_false
idris.note: The strict order refutes the Boolean order the other way.

idris.name: iret_12__lte_b_false_lt
idris.note: The Boolean order, refuted, is the strict order the other way.

idris.name: iret_12__lte_b_true_lte
idris.note: The Boolean order, affirmed, is the order.
